# UnsupportedStringOffsetOperations

<Badge type="danger" text="error" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> <Badge type="info" text="PHP ≥ 7.1" />

Group: [Language level migration](/rules/#language-level-migration) · PhpStorm name: `UnsupportedStringOffsetOperationsInspection`

Writing through a string offset as if it were a nested array
(`$str[0][1] = …`) or appending to a string with `[]` (`$str[] = …`) is a
fatal error since PHP 7.1. When the written-to value is known to be a string,
such writes are bugs.

## Example

```php{8,9,10,11,12,13,15}
<?php
/** @param string[] $words */
function mangle(string $text, array $words, $other) {
    $first = $text[0][0];
    $copy  = [$text[1][0]];
    $text[2] = 'z';

    $text[3][1] = 'y';
    $text['a']['b'] .= 'q';
    [$text[4]['c'], $tail] = $words;
    $text[] = 'w';
    $text[5][] = 'v';
    $words[0][1][2] = 'u';

    $words[0][] = 't';
    $words[] = 'ok';
    $other[0][0] = 1;
    $_SESSION['cart'][] = 'item';
    $_COOKIE['a']['b'] = 'c';
}

$str = 'top';
$str[0][0] = 'x';
```

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 8: String offsets cannot be written as nested arrays (fatal error).</li>
<li>line 9: String offsets cannot be written as nested arrays (fatal error).</li>
<li>line 10: String offsets cannot be written as nested arrays (fatal error).</li>
<li>line 11: Appending with [] is not supported on strings (fatal error).</li>
<li>line 12: String offsets cannot be written as nested arrays (fatal error).</li>
<li>line 13: String offsets cannot be written as nested arrays (fatal error).</li>
<li>line 15: Appending with [] is not supported on strings (fatal error).</li>
</ul>

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "UnsupportedStringOffsetOperations": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore UnsupportedStringOffsetOperations

/**
 * @noinspection UnsupportedStringOffsetOperationsInspection
 */
```
